description: Source code for WebmFrameThread and related classes handling WebM frame processing, threading, and synchronization in Android's stagefright media framework.

classes.name: WebmFrameThread
classes.description: Base class providing threading support for Webm frame processing.

classes.name: WebmFrameSourceThread
classes.description: Thread class for sourcing Webm frames from media sources.

classes.name: WebmFrameSinkThread
classes.description: Thread class for handling Webm frame output, clustering, and cue management.

classes.name: WebmFrameMediaSourceThread
classes.description: Thread class for media source frames, handling start, pause, resume, and run logic.

methods.name: WebmFrameThread::wrap
methods.description: Static method to run the thread's run method.

methods.name: WebmFrameSinkThread::initCluster
methods.description: Initializes a WebM cluster with start timecode and child elements.

methods.name: WebmFrameSinkThread::writeCluster
methods.description: Writes a WebM cluster to the file descriptor.

methods.name: WebmFrameSinkThread::flushFrames
methods.description: Flushes frames into clusters, handling key frames and cluster boundaries.

methods.name: WebmFrameSinkThread::stop
methods.description: Stops the sink thread, pushing EOS frames.

methods.name: WebmFrameSinkThread::run
methods.description: Main loop for processing and clustering frames.

methods.name: WebmFrameMediaSourceThread::start
methods.description: Starts media source thread with metadata.

methods.name: WebmFrameMediaSourceThread::run
methods.description: Main loop for reading media buffers, adjusting timestamps, and pushing frames.
